sloka: अलम् वैक्लवताम् गंतुम् स्वस्था भव निर् उत्सुका ।न च अस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुमान् यो राघवम् रणे ॥३-५९-१४॥
transliteration: alam vaiklavatām gaṁtum svasthā bhava nir utsukā ।na ca asti triṣu lokeṣu pumān yo rāghavam raṇe ॥3-59-14॥

translations.english: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'
translations.hindi: वा हे अजुन वृक्ष ! मेरी प्यारी सीता तुमको बहुत चाहती १ सा बह्‌ जनकदुलारी ओर ड(पोंक जानकी जीवित है कि नहीं- सो बतलाओ
